data.summary: Network Engineer L3 with 8 years of experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise networks. Skilled in managing environments with FortiGate, Cisco ASA, Cisco ISE, Load Balancers, and Cisco switching and routing platforms. Strong at diagnosing and resolving critical network issues while ensuring stable and secure operations.

soft_skills: Collaborated with vendors, field engineers, and cross-functional IT teams
Coordinated with Active Directory, Security, and Application teams
Remote support of on-site engineers and end users/customers
all_skills: Collaborated with vendors, field engineers, and cross-functional IT teams
Coordinated with Active Directory, Security, and Application teams
Remote support of on-site engineers and end users/customers

experience.company: Toyota Tsusho Systems India Pvt Ltd
responsibilities: Managing, configuring, and troubleshooting Citrix ADC (NetScaler) load balancers, including Vservers, service groups, monitors, HA setups, firmware upgrades, and failover testing.
Implementing L4/L7 load balancing, SSL offloading, and content-switching traffic policies to ensure secure and optimized application delivery.
Performing health checks, traffic monitoring, and resolving load balancer-related issues impacting application connectivity and performance.
Cisco VM ISE (Posture with Secure Client & Compliance module), creating administrative access, handling AAA, 802.1X, MAB, profiling, policy configuration, certificates, and pxGrid-related services.
Successfully performed Cisco ISE upgrade activities, including pre-checks, backup validation, patch installation, post-upgrade health checks, and issue resolution.
Acted as the primary point of contact for ISE-related issues, troubleshooting authentication failures, authorization issues, endpoint access problems, and posture-related incidents.
Coordinated with Active Directory, Security, and Application teams to resolve complex ISE integration and access-control issues.
Configured NAC on Layer 2 Cisco switches to provide secure LAN connectivity for end clients.
Collected RA trace logs and debug logs from the WLC for troubleshooting and analysis.

Administered and troubleshot Cisco Wireless infrastructure, managing WLC 5520 and 9800-40 controllers and supporting multiple Cisco Access Point models (1700, 2700, 2800, 3700, 3800, and 9130 series).
Created new SSIDs, configured AAA on WLCs, and created policies, tags, and RF profiles for applying APs, configuring new APs, and performing firmware upgrades.
Worked on Cisco DNA Center (DNAC) for network monitoring, device visibility, client health analysis, assurance troubleshooting, and inventory management.
Performed network monitoring, incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and change implementation in accordance with ITIL processes.
Collaborated with vendors, field engineers, and cross-functional IT teams to resolve high-impact network incidents within defined SLAs.
Prepared and maintained network documentation, change records, and incident reports for operational and audit purposes.
Configured and troubleshot issues related to FHRP protocols such as HSRP and GLBP.
Managed and troubleshot complex LAN/WAN infrastructure, including routing protocols such as EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP.
Implemented and replaced FortiGate and Cisco ASA firewalls with HA/failover setup to ensure uninterrupted network connectivity and secure operations during migrations and maintenance activities
Configured Site-to-Site VPN tunnels, L3 VLANs, DHCP scopes, and security policies for different business networks, along with SD-WAN setup for balancing traffic across multiple ISP links.
Managed VDOM creation in FortiGate and virtual firewall contexts in Cisco ASA to separate network environments and improve security, traffic control, and administration.
Configured and supported Cisco Nexus VPC setup to ensure high availability, redundancy, and smooth Layer 2 connectivity in data Center networks.
Implemented and managed Cisco VSS with EtherChannel to improve core network stability, redundancy, and bandwidth utilization.
Troubleshot VPC and VSS related issues such as peer-link, VSL, STP, LACP, and failover problems to maintain stable network performance and minimize downtime.
Implementing new projects with all type of network devices in different locations.
Configured MPLS links across multiple sites using BGP and VRF to provide secure and reliable WAN connectivity.
Created L3 VLANs on core switches and firewalls, implemented OSPF routing, and redistributed routes between OSPF and BGP for seamless network communication.
Configured BGP prefix-lists and route-maps for route filtering, traffic control, and optimized routing performance.
Configured and managed Cisco Catalyst switches stacks along with Arista MLAG setup to ensure network redundancy, high availability, and stable connectivity in enterprise and data Center environments.
Managing and troubleshooting of complex LAN infrastructure, including routing protocols EIGRP, OSPF & BGP.
Monitoring & Troubleshooting & Replacing Network devices that includes Cisco Routers, Cisco Switches, Juniper switches, ASA Firewall, Firepower 2110.
Implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting ASA Firewall all type of ACL.
Configuring and troubleshooting ASA firewall with Active-Active & Active standby.
Configuring and Troubleshooting ASA Firewall with different type of object NAT, Static NAT, Dynamic NAT, PAT, Static PAT, and Dynamic PAT.
Upgrade, Restoration of IOS and regular configuration backup of switches, Firewall and Routers by using TFTP and FTP servers.
Configuring and troubleshooting l2 and l3 Vlan.
Configuring and troubleshooting of SNMP v3 and Syslog Server (Cisco, Juniper).
Implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting LAN technologies like, VTP, Inter Vlan Routing, RSTP, VLAN Trucking, and Ether-Channel.
IPS/IDS Monitoring and Troubleshooting the Alert’s (Network Level) With FireEye NX Device.
Remote support of on-site engineers and end users/customers during Network issues and installations
Maximizing network performance by monitoring performance, troubleshooting network problems and outages, scheduling upgrades and collaborating with network architects on network optimization
Undertaking data network fault investigations in local and wide area environments, using information from multiple sources
Securing network systems by establishing and enforcing policies, and defining and monitoring access
Route problems to internal support teams - (network, application and desktop support teams).

Provide end user desktop level and Domain related support for Domain Password reset, domain Account unlocking, correcting Host Name issues, date and time Issues, basic software installation, compatibility issues, proxy settings, trusted site issues.
Configuring Vlan and tagging the interfaces Web Proxy Monitoring and L1+ Level Trouble shooting and policies enabling and bypassing the proxy with Force point Security Device.

Balancers, and Cisco switching and routing platforms. Strong at diagnosing and resolving critical
network issues while ensuring stable and secure operations.
